description: Parse an OpenAPI or Postman spec and preview the MCP tools that would be generated, without writing any files. Use this to curate (filter/inspect) before generating.

excludeOperations.description: Drop operations by operationId, tool name, or tag.

format.description: Force a format; defaults to auto-detect.

includeTags.description: Keep only operations with these tags.

methods.description: Keep only these HTTP methods, e.g. [GET, POST].

spec.description: Inline spec text (OpenAPI or Postman; JSON or YAML).

specPath.description: Path to a local spec file (JSON or YAML).

name: analyze_spec
title: Analyze API spec (preview)
